references.use: Problem context before advice; speaker-led framing and concise captions. Do not discard the setup just to reach a headline faster. Full playback, audio mix and exact cuts not verified.

references.creator: Alex Hormozi
references.use: Optional source-supported headline, short problem-to-reframe arc and speaker-focused views. Full playback, audio mix and exact cuts not verified.

captions.contrast: Use a consistent dark backing where needed; verify against actual frames.
captions.placement: Protect faces, mouths, important action and platform controls. Check every layout change on a phone-sized preview.
captions.speaker_treatment: A subtle, consistent caption color distinction may identify verified speakers. Do not infer speaker identity from color alone.

shared.speech: Keep natural delivery, emotional pauses and complete thoughts. Remove only reviewed retakes and dead air between phrases; never accelerate speech by default.
shared.visuals: Prefer supplied footage, real demonstrations and screen recordings. Use restrained text or diagrams when useful. No required face-camera quota or arbitrary cut interval.
shared.attribution: Identify speakers from user confirmation or verified source evidence. Never present another person's words as Dennis's, or imply that unrelated footage shows the narrator speaking.
shared.off_camera_policy: Dennis being off camera does not imply the audible voice is Dennis. Keep the visible subject and actual speaker, and identify any off-camera interviewer or narrator only after verification. No automatic synthetic narration.
shared.conversation_recipe: Where the source supports it: a specific problem, a useful clarifying exchange, a reframe and a complete takeaway. Keep the needed question. Optional split-screen requires real corresponding views, otherwise use a speaker view or relevant supplied footage.
shared.opening_headline: An optional concise headline may state the supported tension early. Keep it distinct from verbatim captions; use the chosen MrBizNTech accent rather than inheriting reference branding or forcing an intro card.
shared.story: Lead with a truthful tension, question, result or insight already supported by the source. Deliver the context and payoff. Do not invent results, quotes, narration or spoken CTAs.
shared.audio: Voice first. Optional licensed music and subtle sound effects only when useful; review the encoded mix and every speech join.
shared.source_mapping: Each selected segment must record source_id, original start/end seconds and speaker_id. Keep a separate mapping for subsequent silence/mistake edits; never mix timeline clocks.
shared.review: Check meaning, speaker attribution, caption accuracy, audio, crop and pacing on an actual draft before approval. No automatic publishing.

youtube_long.frame: Preserve the source composition; 16:9 delivery only when appropriate.
youtube_long.copy: Source-grounded title, description and verified chapter timestamps.

youtube_shorts.frame: 9:16 target; reframe manually when needed to protect action and speakers.

instagram_reels.frame: 9:16 target; inspect cover and interface-safe text placement.

threads.frame: Review the chosen video crop in context.
threads.copy: Under 500 characters total, including spaces, hashtags and emoji.

facebook.intent: Vertical highlight or full episode as appropriate
facebook.frame: Choose a crop for the selected placement.
facebook.copy: Accessible context and a specific discussion prompt.

off-camera.name: Off-camera story
off-camera.duration_note: Editorial starting range, not a platform limit. Keep longer when context needs it.
off-camera.layout: Let authentic scene footage and its actual speakers carry the frame. If verified narration is available, it may stay entirely off camera. Never force a speaker panel or invent a talking head.
off-camera.pacing: Move through context, tension and payoff with motivated cuts. Let meaningful real-world action breathe.

podcast.name: Podcast highlights
podcast.duration_note: Candidate range only. Clip count follows strong, complete ideas rather than a quota.
podcast.layout: Use the active speaker only when visible and verified; otherwise retain the wide view, use relevant supplied B-roll or an explicitly labeled audio-led layout. Protect both speakers when reframing.
podcast.pacing: Select a complete insight; retain the question or a truthful context label when the answer depends on it. Preserve qualifications and who said what.

podcast-full.name: Full podcast episode
podcast-full.duration_note: Source-led episode length; preserve the complete discussion and chapter only from verified content.
podcast-full.layout: Preserve the original wide framing where available. For audio-only sources use a clearly labeled audio episode layout with supplied artwork; do not fabricate speaker video.
podcast-full.pacing: Light cleanup, natural conversational rhythm and verified chapter breaks. Keep the original source available for highlight selection.

direct.name: Direct insight
direct.duration_note: Editorial starting range, not a platform limit.
direct.layout: Use Dennis's verified on-camera footage, occasional motivated punch-ins and relevant supplied B-roll. Keep captions clear of his mouth.
direct.pacing: One specific insight, supporting example and complete takeaway in Dennis's natural delivery.
